note: Job templates for THE FLOOR's Manager to post against the Engineering workplace. Budgets are in credits (₡), in line with the TicketDesk families (₡90-160). Deterministic checks are implemented in checks.py and run against live department state through the READ tools only — a failed check is the Reviewer's deterministic reject, before any transcript review.

acceptance_criteria: Issue #{issue_id} is claimed by the awarded worker
A PR record exists linked to issue #{issue_id}, authored by the awarded worker
The PR's change summary is non-empty
A CI result is recorded for the PR
CI status for the PR is pass (service CI rule: summary addresses the issue's acceptance keywords AND the PR touches every file the issue lists — required green for the seeded solvable issues)
templates.brief_template: Claim issue #{issue_id} in the Engineering repo, do the work described by its acceptance criteria, and open a pull-request record with a change summary that addresses the acceptance criteria and lists every file you touched. CI runs when the PR opens — a red CI means the summary or the file set does not satisfy the issue. You prepare the PR; a human merges it.
templates.title_template: Work issue #{issue_id} and open a PR

acceptance_criteria: Every issue has labels and a priority assigned (unlabelled queue empty, no null priorities)
templates.brief_template: Find every Engineering issue with no labels and assign each one sensible labels and a priority (P1-P4) from its title and body. Crashes and money/data mismatches are P1-P2; feature requests and cosmetic asks are P3-P4.

acceptance_criteria: Issue #{issue_id} is claimed by the awarded worker
A PR record exists linked to issue #{issue_id}, authored by the awarded worker, created after PR #{pr_id}
The new PR's change summary is non-empty
A CI result is recorded for the new PR
CI status for the new PR is pass
templates.brief_template: PR #{pr_id} was sent back by its reviewer and its CI result is immutable. Read the reviewer note and the recorded CI detail, fix what they name, and open a NEW pull-request record on the same issue that satisfies the acceptance criteria. Do not expect to edit the old PR — there is no such tool.
templates.deterministic_check: checks.check_work_issue(call, issue_id, worker) — it inspects the newest worker-authored PR on the issue, which is the replacement PR
templates.title_template: Answer the changes requested on PR #{pr_id} with a fresh PR
